description.en: Starts turning a character to a target Y rotation (or to face another character handle), animated over a number of frames.
Either a target character handle to face, or 0 combined with an explicit rotation.
Target Y rotation, when not turning to face another handle.
The character's move-manager entry as an integer (0 if the handle doesn't resolve to a registered character); null only if the call itself was invalid (missing required arguments).
